title: KAITO — It's Okay, Everyone〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Background. Check. Lights. Check... Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, we can start rehearsing whenever.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene! Emu! Everything ready over there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We're all set!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's start rehearsing...
“A Wondrous Spring Break With Some”...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Mom, I said I don't want to...!
Why are you making me go to someone else's house?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “I'm not going! I don't want a little brother if it means I have to be dragged away from you and Dad! I don't want to be a big sister either!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Well done, Nene.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It's just her on stage right now, but it really feels like she's arguing with her parents.)

“Hah hah hah hah!
A hearty hello from below!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Wahhh! M-Monster!”

rows.Speaker: Some
rows.Line:
“Huh? I'm no monster!
My name's Some!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“S-Some...?
Do you live in this village?”

rows.Speaker: Some
rows.Line:
“Uhh...
I've been living here my whole life, so...probably♪”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Probably...?”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I was told that they haven't had many chances to practice it all the way through, but they seem to be more than ready.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka, they've already started rehearsing. All because you refused to wake up.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But the sheep in my dream were begging me to stay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Welcome, you two.
You said that you'd both show up, so I was starting to get worried.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As you can see, Luka overslept again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, where's Miku?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
She's helping with the show backstage.
Oh, there she is...

rows.Speaker: Some
rows.Line:
“I can do stuff like this♪
Just watch! Voila☆”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. She's the one making the cherry blossom petals fall.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. The plushies agreed to help out as well after we told them that we'd be using the snow basket again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. The way they're dancing as they fall is so beautiful... Just watching them is making me sleepy...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, they haven't even gotten to the best part yet!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Uncle...! There you are! Thank goodness!”

rows.Speaker: Uncle
rows.Line:
“Wh-What are you doing here?!
You know you're not supposed to go into the woods at night!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “But I was so worried about you...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “L-Let's go home, together...”

rows.Speaker: Uncle
rows.Line:
“Home...?
I see... You're willing to call it your home now.”

rows.Speaker: Uncle
rows.Line:
“Yes, let's go home.
We need to tell your auntie that we're both safe.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Yeah...!”

rows.Speaker: Male Villager
rows.Line:
“Look, it's them! Over here!
Hey, you both okay?!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Thank goodness. MEIKO, can I borrow your handkerchief...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Sorry, I'm already using it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Here, you can borrow mine.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really? Thank you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Some!
Thank you so much for helping me find my uncle yesterday!”

rows.Speaker: Some
rows.Line:
“You're welcome...
I'm just glad that I could help you somehow.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Some...?
What's wrong? You sound really tired.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Oh no! The cherry blossoms are starting to fall off!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Wait, is this because you helped me yesterday...?!”

rows.Speaker: Some
rows.Line: “No, that's not quite it. I was actually supposed to start resting a long time ago...”

rows.Speaker: Some
rows.Line: “But I wasn't ready to say goodbye to you just yet... Hehe. So, I decided to push my limits a little...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Some...”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Luka
rows.Line: Someeee!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shh! I understand how you feel, but please try to calm down!

rows.Speaker: Some
rows.Line: “Don't worry. I'm just gonna go to sleep for a little bit to make sure these cherry blossoms bloom again next year.”

rows.Speaker: Some
rows.Line: “Are you coming back again next year? If you do, I'm gonna do my best to keep these cherry blossoms in bloom for waaay longer.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Yeah, I'm definitely coming back.
I'll even bring my little brother next time.”

rows.Speaker: Some
rows.Line:
“Huh?
What happened to not wanting to become a big sister?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “I'm over that now. I promise to become a really nice big sister like you, Some.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, this scene's based on your advice, right, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The thing is, it involves one of my wishes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Your wish?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe that Tsukasa and the others have the power necessary to overcome whatever hurdles they end up facing...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I want to do something to support their efforts instead of just watching from the seats.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For instance, we could help pull them over the top as opposed to just pushing them from below.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I like it!
I like it a lot!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree completely.
I can't wait to see how their feelings evolve moving forward.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm glad that you both feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (If everyone's feelings keep growing... If that place becomes a “real SEKAI”, what kind of song will be born from it?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing what the future has in store for us.)
